about: Wikidata's men's national teams that have a player stint of 1960 to 1993, those stints and their players, from QLever's answers pinned in scripts/data/national-team-seasons.json (CC0). Rows: teams [qid, country]; players [qid, name, born, English Wikipedia article, positions]; stints [player, team, from, to, caps, goals, ended], ended 1 where Wikidata gives no end and the manifest's rule does (selection.openCapsPerYear). Written by scripts/sync-national-team-seasons.mjs.
